section.description: about: About (Project and team overview.); news: News (Announcements, newsletters, and updates.); classes: Classes (Playable Voxie character classes.); titan-arena: Titan Arena (Titan Arena overview and roster.); game-download: Game Download (Download and install Voxie Tactics.); voxel-token: Get Voxel (VOXEL token information.); faq: FAQ (Frequently asked questions and support guidance.); careers: Careers (Open roles and hiring information.)
